title: Official practice assessment
summary: Microsoft's own free GH-100 practice assessment: exam-style questions with explanations, unlimited attempts, scored by domain. The closest thing to the real item style that exists.
markdown:
Microsoft publishes a **free official practice assessment** for GH-100. It is not reproduced here — it is an interactive Microsoft product, and it is better used where it lives.

[**Open the official GH-100 practice assessment →**](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/github-administration/practice/assessment?assessment-type=practice&assessmentId=1841205577&practice-assessment-type=certification)

## Why this matters more than any third-party bank

Microsoft writes these to mirror *"the style, wording, and difficulty of the questions that you are likely to experience on this exam"*. Nothing in this workbench — including the questions written for it — can claim that. Treat the official assessment as your calibration and this site as your coverage.

Two caveats Microsoft states directly:

- The questions are **not** the same as the ones on the exam.
- It is not representative of exam **length** or **complexity** — the real exam may include additional question types, case studies, and possibly labs.

## How to use it

1. Sit it cold, before revising, to get an honest baseline.
2. Work through every explanation, including for questions you got right.
3. Come back here for the domains it exposed as weak — this workbench covers all 39 objectives, whereas the assessment samples them.
4. Re-sit it a few days before the exam.

Attempts are unlimited and the question order is shuffled, so a second sitting is a genuine re-test rather than a memory check.

## GH-600 has no equivalent

Only some certifications have a practice assessment. GH-600 does not, which is part of why this workbench exists.
